model.verdict: No: the signal model has not shown skill. No horizon has at least 500 out-of-sample rows with a Brier skill above 0.0 against the base rate and an AUC 95% interval above 0.5. Its paper long beats a baseline after costs on: 3d open_to_close p>=0.55 vs benchmark_long_per_date; 5d open_to_close p>=0.55 vs benchmark_long_per_date.
